requirement.normalizedRequirement: Set C_3 = 845 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_4 = 42 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_5 = 825 kg/s^2 and psi = atan(tan(phi_2)/sin(alpha)). Clamp ((L*T)/B^2)^3 to the inclusive interval [5, 20]. Table 3-2 values: f1=23 N/m2, f2=45.8 N/m, f3=14.7 N/m, f4=29 N/m2, g1=1530 N, g2=170 N/m, g3=400 N/m1.5.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: Coefficients f_1-f_4 and g_1-g_3 are given in Table 3-2. C_3 = 845 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_4 = 42 kg/(m^2*s^2), C_5 = 825 kg/s^2. psi = atan(tan(phi_2)/sin(alpha)). If the value of the term ((L*T)/B^2)^3 is less than 5, the value 5 shall be used; if the value is more than 20, the value 20 shall be used. Table 3-2 values: f1=23 N/m2, f2=45.8 N/m, f3=14.7 N/m, f4=29 N/m2, g1=1530 N, g2=170 N/m, g3=400 N/m1.5.
